meta.prompt: Show the plan for migrating my blog as six steps: Back up your content, Set up the new host, Import posts, Move media, Redirect old URLs, Final checks, each with a short description. A Start button runs them one after another, 2 seconds each: a spinner on the running step, ticks on the finished ones, a progress bar that reads "N of 6 steps" with the seconds elapsed, and a Pause button. When all six are done, a summary says "Migration complete" and the total time in seconds.
meta.text:
ChatCard "Blog migration" "Six steps, about 12 seconds" icon:"swap_horiz" status:"Ready"
  state running=false
  state done=0
  state paused=false
  state elapsed=0
  let total = 6
  every 1000 when running -> elapsed += 1; done = min(total, done + 0)
  every 2000 when running -> done = min(total, done + 1); running = done + 1 < total
  PlanStep "Back up your content" "Export posts, pages and comments to a safe copy." index:0 current:=done running:=running
  PlanStep "Set up the new host" "Create the new site and install the blog software." index:1 current:=done running:=running
  PlanStep "Import posts" "Bring every post across with its dates and tags." index:2 current:=done running:=running
  PlanStep "Move media" "Copy images and files to the new storage." index:3 current:=done running:=running
  PlanStep "Redirect old URLs" "Point every old address at its new page." index:4 current:=done running:=running
  PlanStep "Final checks" "Test links, forms and search, then go live." index:5 current:=done running:=running
  ProgressLine "{done} of 6 steps" "{elapsed} s elapsed" value:=done/total
  if done == 0 and !running
    ActionButton "Start" primary icon:"play_arrow" enabled:true -> running=true; paused=false
  if running
    ActionButton "Pause" quiet icon:"pause" -> running=false; paused=true
  if done == total
    Receipt "Migration complete" "Total time: {elapsed} seconds." tone:good icon:"check"
